blocking_finding.issue: RN guard checks x87 rounding and MXCSR FTZ/DAZ but omits MXCSR rounding bits 0x6000. The local libm fegetround disassembly uses fnstcw and mask 0xc00 only. Thus AVX/FMA can use a different rounding mode while this guard reports success.
blocking_finding.evidence_scope: A concrete contract-check defect, not evidence that existing synthetic or Stage0 outputs used a wrong rounding mode.
blocking_finding.minimal_closure: Add MXCSR rounding-mask equality to nearest in the new FMA guard; preserve immutable Stage0. Freeze a narrow new revision and rerun existing synthetic. No new scientific grid is required.

oracle_interpretation_required: Actual stored/dequantized U is used correctly. With relative SVD cutoff 1e-10 the residual uses a numerically truncated span; if nonzero singular directions are discarded it need not lower-bound the full actual span. Finite FMA rounding also leaves the real-valued span. Treat this as a scoped diagnostic, not a universal rounded-kernel/all-U/NLL bound.
baseline_rebuild_interpretation: A rebuilt baseline hash is diagnostic only; a material discrepancy needs explanation before claiming the same frozen estimator. It does not authorize replacing the frozen baseline.
